name: John N. Erlenborn
summary: John Neal Erlenborn (February 8, 1927 – October 30, 2005) was an American lawyer and politician who served as a Republican member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Illinois, representing the 14th (then after 1980s redistricting the 13th) district. In all, he served 10 consecutive terms from 1965 to 1985.
